subject.stdout_disposition: retain exact complete bytes; input-1 correctness is not inferred from the input-1000 oracle

mutex.hold: tool and input replay through owned cleanup and final artifact closure

capture_sequence: After exclusive tool intake, bind exact LLDB, scripting Python, debugserver, their dependencies and selected configuration; disable user init and expression evaluation.

During separate tool intake, validate module UUIDs, matching DWARF types and file-address APIs without launching the subject. Before the capture, preopen separate target stdout/stderr, debugger logs and durable event output.

Directly posix_spawn the unchanged executable once with argument 1, DEVNULL, exact file descriptors/environment, START_SUSPENDED and a new process group. Register its PID slot before spawn, then its exact birth/group and kernel-stopped state before debugger creation.

Launch the exact debugserver as a separate registered direct child using [debugserver, private_unix_socket, --attach=owned_subject_pid]. After endpoint readiness, start the separately registered LLDB client with its exact configuration. Attach only this newly created stopped owned child; never accept an external PID or let LLDB launch an opaque inferior.

Before the client connects or resumes, create its LLDB target for the exact executable; add the retained runtime and matching DWARF; revalidate UUIDs, architecture, type layout and every file-address breakpoint. Subscribe to target module-load/unload and process events before ConnectRemote. The already owned Julia child remains stopped throughout this setup.

Record the initial owned launch stop separately; bind its PID, LLDB unique process ID and independently recorded birth identity through Trace.bind_owned_process before resume. Feed only registered breakpoint stops to Trace.stopped with strictly advancing stop IDs. Preserve all module events and unexpected stops; no expression or function evaluation in the inferior.
Record normal exit and all raw output. On any cap, interruption or unexpected stop, terminate and reap every registered owned process/group without retry, retaining the partial capture.
Recheck physical inputs, exact raw artifacts, process identities and mutex name/inode before closing the capture. Semantic review remains separate from capture completion.
required_positive_witnesses: Exactly one main/exported-entry path, native clbg entry, fresh-state constructor and original driver.
At entry_indirect_call, actual x8 equals the resolved retained native_clbg_entry address; save world values and ABI converter observations rather than assuming the branch.
Two energy entries around one nbody entry, x1 equal to 1 at nbody entry, and exactly one nbody_decrement stop with x13 equal to 1 before decrement.
Every interpreter/codegen breakpoint has exactly one resolved location throughout the run; a known native stop calibrates observation. Zero hit counts without these conditions prove nothing.
Raw cfuncdata and each directly selected CodeInstance snapshot are retained with DWARF field offsets, invoke/specptr/inferred values, and bounded inferred object header bytes.
unresolved_before_prepare: Exact debugger/debugserver/scripting-runtime physical intake and native API compatibility have not been performed.

controller.py now wires metadata-only prepare and one-shot owned run to owned_processes.py and client.py, including exact client/config bytes and final input/artifact closure. These sources and their fault cases remain unexecuted. Exact SDK/API compatibility and a separately reviewed physical tool-intake receipt are required. The ordinary single-child observer is insufficient evidence by itself.
Exact module UUIDs and matching DWARF type visibility must be validated before launch; unresolved addresses or fields must stop preparation.
Complete environment, working directory and fresh output paths must be made concrete; no shell/default debugger settings are permitted.
limits_of_inference: A bounded input-1 trace is a diagnostic, not a performance sample or full-size required-work run.
Generic ABI converter or compile-method lookup hits do not alone establish interpretation or new LLVM code generation.
A non-null CodeInstance.inferred value does not alone establish retained executable IR: the retained header permits CodeInfo, compressed String, jl_nothing and UInt8 dispositions.
This capture does not inspect every reachable Method.source, opaque closure or alternate/error path; it cannot alone establish universal IR removal or fallback closure.
